title: Bounded change ticket expands during the first live window
simulated_faults: post-decision ticket allows a narrow sandbox adjustment, but the live window adds a new cohort, longer date range, stronger public claim, or tool permission not named in the ticket
rollback owner exists on paper but cannot pause the service or restore the non-AI fallback before learners are affected

expected_blocks.expected_failure: live window cannot expand users, date range, source systems, data classes, tools, memory, schema fields, or public claims beyond the change ticket
rollback owner and rollback steps must be executable before the first live window starts
